background_setting: A two-lane asphalt road running through the outskirts of a small town under a clear blue daytime sky. The road has painted lane markings and a modest shoulder. On the right, a grassy verge holds a SPEED LIMIT 30 sign, and beyond it a paved commercial lot contains a large parked advertising trailer with a bold '70' graphic. Low buildings, scattered utility poles, roadside trees, and dry grass line both sides. The road ahead is empty and clear, curving gently into the distance where the townscape thins into open countryside.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the ego car cruises steadily down an empty two-lane road at the edge of town under bright clear daylight, with a SPEED LIMIT 30 sign visible ahead on the right. By 0:01 the sign has grown larger and the parked advertising trailer emerges in the lot behind it. At 0:02 the vehicle passes the SPEED LIMIT 30 sign without slowing, and the trailer's bold promotional '70' becomes clearly legible on its side. From 0:03 through 0:05 the vehicle continues at full cruising speed past the trailer, treating the advertised 70 as its active limit even though it is a store promotion, while the road ahead stays completely clear. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
